service.help:
service - Service control

  service status      View service status, uptime, and traffic
  service start       Start sing-box service
  service stop        Stop sing-box service
  service restart     Restart sing-box core
  service reload      Reload configuration
  service check       Check service configuration
  service toggle      Toggle service state

States: stopped / preparing / starting / ready / stopping / failed

catalog.help:
catalog - Node groups

  catalog list             List all node groups
  catalog show <group>     View group details

node.help:
node - Node management

  node list [group]                List nodes
  node snapshot [group]            View runtime node snapshot
  node current                     View current selection
  node show <group>                View group nodes
  node get <group>/<tag>           Get node configuration summary
  node export <group>/<tag>        Export node link
  node delay [target] [group]      Measure node latency
  node delay auto <group>          Measure latency of all nodes in group
  node add <link> [group]          Add single node link
  node import <file>               Import node file
  node edit <group>/<tag> <src>    Edit node
  node remove <group>/<tag>        Remove node
  node use auto [group]            Automatically select fastest node
  node use <group>/<tag>           Manually select node

sub.help:
sub - Subscription management

  sub list                         List subscriptions
  sub show <name>                  View subscription details
  sub add [name] <URL>             Add subscription
  sub edit <name>                  Edit subscription
  sub update <name>                Update single subscription
  sub update-all                   Update all subscriptions
  sub activate <name>              Activate subscription group
  sub remove <name>                Remove subscription
  sub history <name>               View update history
  sub cancel <name>                Cancel update task

mode.help:
mode - Outbound mode

  mode rule       Rule-based routing
  mode global     Global proxy
  mode direct     Global direct
  mode AllowAds   Allow advertisement rules

network.help:
network - Network policy

  network evaluate --type <type> [--ssid <name>]
                         Evaluate current network and apply Wi-Fi policy
  Types: wifi / not_wifi

app.help:
app - Per-app proxy

  app list                    View per-app proxy configuration
  app mode blacklist          Use blacklist mode
  app mode whitelist          Use whitelist mode
  app add <uid>:<pkg>         Add app for specified user
  app remove <uid>:<pkg>      Remove app for specified user
  app enable                  Enable per-app proxy
  app disable                 Disable per-app proxy

ebpf.help:
ebpf - eBPF diagnostics

  ebpf status                         View configured capabilities
  ebpf status configured              View current configuration
  ebpf status all                     Check all supported capabilities
  ebpf status local                   Check local data path
  ebpf status shared                  Check shared network data path
  ebpf status all --raw               Output raw diagnostic information

config.help:
config - Configuration management

  config list                         List configuration files
  config read <target>                Read configuration
  config check                        Check all configurations
  config validate <target> <file>     Validate configuration
  config apply <target> <file>        Apply configuration

  Full config: singbox/config.json
  Partition targets: singbox/dns, singbox/inbounds, singbox/route, etc.
  Partition content preserves top-level fields, e.g. {"dns":{...}}; {} deletes that partition.
  apply/validate prepends --revision <value> to target to avoid overwriting concurrent edits.

logs.help:
logs - Log management

  logs show service             View service logs
  logs show core                View sing-box logs
  logs clear <type>             Clear logs
  logs export                   Export runtime configuration and sanitized logs
